nodes.description: Public owner address of Owned; privileged account controlling onlyOwner gated functions.
Pending owner candidate set by changeOwner and confirmed by acceptOwnership.
Owned constructor: owner = msg.sender, initial privilege assignment.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner candidate.
Confirms ownership transfer when msg.sender == ownerCandidate.
Owned modifier onlyOwner: require(msg.sender == owner); acts as access-control gate.
Public multiplier (percent) applied to deposits to compute participant payout.
Public cursor into participants array used by payout loop.
Address of the POWH contract used by notPowh and cast to POWH.
POWH contract instance targeted by buy/withdraw external calls in payout and withdraw.
Public array of Participant structs (etherAddress, payout) tracking depositors.
BoomerangLiquidity constructor: sets multiplier, powh_address and casts POWH instance.
Payable fallback function that silently accepts ether.
Payable deposit: pushes Participant(msg.sender, msg.value*multiplier/100) then calls payout.
Public payout loop: forwards half balance to POWH.buy, then sends ether to participants in order.
Public withdraw: calls weak_hands.withdraw with forwarded gas.
Payable donate function that accepts ether without accounting.
onlyOwner + notPowh function that transfers arbitrary ERC20 tokens to owner.
BoomerangLiquidity modifier onlyOwner: require(msg.sender == owner); access-control gate.
Modifier notPowh(address aContract): require(aContract != powh_address) to block the POWH token.
msg.sender: untrusted caller used for ownership, authorization checks, participant records and POWH.buy recipient.
External value call weak_hands.buy.value(investment).gas(1000000)(msg.sender) inside payout; state is not finalized before the call, enabling reentrancy.
participants[payoutOrder].etherAddress.send(payoutToSend) inside payout; external ether transfer with limited gas that can re-enter.
Fallback path address.call.value(payoutToSend).gas(1000000)() inside payout; unchecked low-level call forwarding ether and gas.
External call weak_hands.withdraw.gas(1000000)() inside withdraw; no state protection against re-entrancy.
ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) external call in transferAnyERC20Token; return value used but external call may re-enter.
Arithmetic (msg.value * multiplier) / 100 in deposit; multiplication can overflow in Solidity 0.4.x.
Arithmetic balance -= investment in payout; unchecked subtraction on tracked balance.
Arithmetic participants[payoutOrder].payout -= payoutToSend in payout; unchecked subtraction on participant accounting.
Arithmetic payoutOrder += 1 in payout loop; unchecked increment with array bounds check only afterwards.
Parameter _newOwner of changeOwner(address _newOwner).
Parameter multiplierPercent of BoomerangLiquidity(uint multiplierPercent, address powh).
Parameter powh of BoomerangLiquidity(uint multiplierPercent, address powh).
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens).
Parameter tokens (amount) of transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens).
Parameter aContract of modifier notPowh(address aContract).
Local variable balance in payout holding address(this).balance.
Local variable investment = balance / 2 forwarded to POWH.buy in payout.
Local variable payoutToSend computed per participant and sent in payout.
ERC20Interface.totalSupply declaration (external interface function, no body).
ERC20Interface.balanceOf declaration (external interface function, no body).
ERC20Interface.allowance declaration (external interface function, no body).
ERC20Interface.transfer declaration invoked by transferAnyERC20Token.
ERC20Interface.approve declaration (external interface function, no body).
ERC20Interface.transferFrom declaration (external interface function, no body).
POWH.buy(address) payable declaration targeted by weak_hands.buy.value(...) in payout.
POWH.withdraw() declaration targeted by weak_hands.withdraw.gas(...) in withdraw.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender (untrusted caller) directly to owner, granting privileges.
onlyOwner modifier evaluates require(msg.sender == owner) on untrusted caller input.
BoomerangLiquidity onlyOwner modifier evaluates require(msg.sender == owner) on untrusted caller input.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == ownerCandidate, using untrusted caller for privilege transfer.
onlyOwner guards execution of changeOwner.
onlyOwner guards execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
notPowh restricts which token addresses transferAnyERC20Token may act on.
changeOwner writes the supplied address into ownerCandidate for later privilege escalation.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with ownerCandidate, completing privileged ownership transfer.
Constructor writes multiplierPercent into the multiplier state variable.
Constructor writes powh argument into powh_address state variable.
Constructor casts powh_address into the weak_hands POWH instance.
multiplierPercent parameter flows into constructor initialization.
powh parameter flows into constructor initialization of powh_address and weak_hands.
_newOwner parameter flows into changeOwner assignment of ownerCandidate.
tokenAddress parameter determines the external ERC20 contract called in transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens parameter is the amount transferred in transferAnyERC20Token.
aContract parameter is compared against powh_address in the notPowh modifier.
deposit records msg.sender as the Participant etherAddress of the new deposit.
deposit pushes a new Participant entry into the participants array.
deposit computes (msg.value * multiplier) / 100, an unchecked multiplication that can overflow.
deposit calls payout() immediately after recording the participant.
payout reads and mutates participants[payoutOrder] payout and etherAddress fields.
payout transfers half the balance via external POWH.buy value call before finishing account updates.
msg.sender is forwarded as the recipient argument of the external POWH.buy call.
local investment (balance/2) is attached as value to the external POWH.buy call in payout.
payout sends ether to a participant via send after computing payoutToSend in the loop.
payout falls back to low-level call.value inside the loop when send fails.
Failed send branch transfers control to the unchecked call.value fallback path in payout.
local balance derived from address(this).balance drives the amount sent in the payout loop.
local payoutToSend is the amount forwarded via send to participants[payoutOrder].etherAddress.
local payoutToSend is forwarded as value in the low-level call.value fallback.
payout performs unchecked subtraction balance -= investment.
payout performs unchecked subtraction on participant payout accounting.
payout increments payoutOrder without overflow checks before validating array bounds.
External POWH.buy call can re-enter payout (or deposit) before payout accounting completes.
Participant etherAddress fallback triggered by send can re-enter payout.
Participant fallback triggered by call.value can re-enter payout with supplied gas.
withdraw performs an external call to weak_hands.withdraw with forwarded gas.
External POWH.withdraw call can re-enter BoomerangLiquidity.withdraw.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external ERC20 transfer call.
Malicious token contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token can re-enter the function or other contract functions.
owner is used as the recipient of the ERC20 transfer in transferAnyERC20Token.
weak_hands state variable is the target contract of the external buy value call in payout.
weak_hands state variable is the target contract of the external withdraw call.
multiplier state variable participates in the deposit payout computation that can overflow.
payoutOrder state variable is incremented in the payout loop and bounds-checked only afterwards.
External ERC20 transfer call resolves to ERC20Interface.transfer on the caller-supplied token contract.
Value-bearing external call resolves to POWH.buy on the weak_hands contract.
External call resolves to POWH.withdraw on the weak_hands contract.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner exists solely to be stored into ownerCandidate inside changeOwner.
multiplierPercent is only used to initialize the multiplier state variable in the constructor.
powh is only used to set powh_address and cast weak_hands in the constructor.
tokenAddress is only used to instantiate ERC20Interface for the external transfer call.
tokens is only used as the transfer amount argument in transferAnyERC20Token.
aContract is only used in the require comparison against powh_address inside notPowh.
local balance is the payout accounting variable read from address(this).balance inside payout.
local investment is computed and forwarded as value to POWH.buy inside payout.
local payoutToSend is the per-participant amount sent inside the payout loop.
